name: redpen-codex
description: A private language coach for ChatGPT desktop and Codex that scores prompts, highlights corrections, and suggests native phrasing without changing the original prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Private, passive language coaching while you work
interface.longDescription: Scores your phrasing, highlights corrections, and offers a native-style alternative in English, Chinese, Spanish, or Japanese. The ChatGPT desktop launcher and Codex hook keep the original prompt unchanged and show feedback only to you.
defaultPrompt: Set redpen to coach my English with native-style hints.
